finding.text: The new cost cell (the preview row) is not visible in any shot. Every row shown has an empty Cost column (only the old `$0.02` on a Servex echo row), so ask 3 is unproven at the list level. Evidence: shots/…sessions/1920.png, rows band, Cost column. The index did load (its defect banner draws), so the rows on screen are just not in `session-index.json`. Either index the sessions the grid shows, or show "not measured" instead of a blank. The detail view was never shot.

At 1200 and below, the Cost column (the one this task changed) sits off-screen to the right. 1200.png cuts the grid off at Model. The Cost column grew from 5rem to 12rem, at the far end of an 11-column grid. Ask 3's "check at the four widths" shows it at 1920 and 3440 only.
The filter row has no gaps: "SHOW CLOSED☐ NEEDS ATTENTIONfrom" runs together (1200.png and 1920.png, filter band). `gap-100` does not seem to apply between the labels and the date range.

Addendum: the "needs attention" filter is a checkbox on `alerts` being present. Nothing sorts by alert priority (`level`), and the table does not sort by tag either. The owner asked for "prioritized" and "filters/sorts by tag".

The diff commits about 22,500 generated lines in `sessions/files.jsonl` (it repeats `spend-tree.json`/`week.json` "gone" lines) and about 120 new `sessions/<uuid>/files.jsonl` files. Each new file lists only a gitignored `cache.jsonl`, so the static site will list folders whose content is not in git. This is a directory manifest of machine state. It should be reverted out of the commit, or the watcher kept away from gitignored files.

The defect banner "⚠ 810 spawned agents with no recorded parent … minion-fence-proof, minion-count-demo, …" is the widest text on the page (layout.json widest_text_sample at 1200/1920/3440). It sits on level 1 as raw ids. It belongs one click down, or as one short line with a link.

Ask 4 says the cache goes in `session.jsonl`. The build splits it into `cache.jsonl` (gitignored, rebuildable) and `session.jsonl` (the tracked record). The reason is stated in doc/session-class.md and it is sound: the alternative is the owner's literal shape. This is acceptable, but the owner should see it on the card.
`doc/record-spec.md` tells writers to run `C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/session-class/Server/session-summary.mjs` with `SESSIONS_ROOT`. That path goes stale the moment the branch merges.
The Audit and Close buttons are `span role=button`, not `<button>` (ui questions). The Close block's indentation in SessionView.js is off by one level.

layout.json lists one 404 per width. It is likely an old file such as `week.json`. The four week tiles all show "—" (1920.png, top band). This was stale before this change (findings §7), but the tiles still show no "as of".
